faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes G63 AMG 6x6 use?
faqLeft.a: The G63 AMG 6x6 uses the M157 — a 5.5-litre twin-turbo V8. It was produced between 2013 and 2015 as a special-edition vehicle.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes G63 AMG 6x6 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my G63 AMG 6x6?
faqLeft.a: All G63 AMG 6x6 models use the M157 engine. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact vehicle specification.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M157 G63 AMG 6x6 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace valve seals, coolant components, timing chain components and bearings as standard on every M157 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used G63 AMG 6x6 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my G63 AMG 6x6 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a G63 AMG 6x6 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most G63 AMG 6x6 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
